name: Barycentric Interpolation on Tetrahedra
definition: Interpolation within a tetrahedron (3-simplex) using 3D barycentric coordinates, extending 2D barycentric coordinates by relating four tetrahedral subvolumes.
summary: Barycentric Interpolation on Tetrahedra directly computes weighted sums of four vertex values using 3D barycentric coordinates, offering a closed-form solution for unstructured volumetric data unlike iterative hexahedral methods.
